solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Startle, prepared to keep ace and not lead

parts.note: to startle someone is to take them aback

indicators.note: one piece keeping another holds it within itself

parts.note: prepared means set, as in all set
A is the card abbreviation for ace

explanation.surface: A card player is startled, ready to keep an ace but not to lead with it.
explanation.walkthrough: The card-table surface makes 'not lead' look like a bridge instruction; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a back seat is an idiom for letting others take charge rather than leading.

clue.text: Old broadcaster's second trailer for good stuff on compiler

definitions.note: the clue's 's is read as 'is', so this is the definition

parts.note: the one trailing behind second place is third
pro means for, in favour of
to stuff is to ram, cram in
the setter of a crossword refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: An old radio station's second preview for a quality show about the person who compiled it.
explanation.walkthrough: The Third Programme was the BBC's highbrow radio network, renamed Radio 3 in 1967. 'on' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The Third Programme was a BBC radio network from 1946, long since replaced, so an old broadcaster.

clue.text: Frolic about, holding a pen

indicators.note: the turned word holds the letter a inside it
about tells us the word for frolic is turned round

parts.note: a frolic is a lark, a bit of fun

explanation.surface: Animals or children romping around while kept in an enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A kraal is a southern African enclosure for livestock, so a pen.

clue.text: Land almost nothing, after a West Indian lands one

indicators.note: after puts the shortened nothing behind the letter a
almost means the word for nothing loses its final letter

parts.note: nothing is zero

indicators.note: the West Indian lands, catches, the one inside him

parts.note: a Bajan is a person from Barbados
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A Caribbean traveller arrives in a country with next to nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lands' is a verb of catching here (as in landing a fish), so BAJAN takes I inside to give BAIJAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Azerbaijan is a country in the Caucasus, a land in the sense of a nation.

clue.text: Injurious commercial, very Irish

parts.note: a commercial is an ad
Erse is the Irish Gaelic language

explanation.surface: A very Irish advertisement that does harm.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverse effects are harmful ones, so adverse is a synonym of harmful.

clue.text: Came together and kept busy at the guillotine?

definitions.meaning: bones that heal are said to knit, joining together
women of the French Revolution sat knitting beside executions

explanation.surface: Someone who joined others and stayed occupied while the blade fell.
explanation.walkthrough: The tricoteuses were Parisian women famed for knitting while watching guillotine executions.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitted is past tense: broken bones knitted, joined; and the tricoteuses knitted during executions.

clue.text: Like some spuds? I had to speak

indicators.note: spoken, the contraction sounds like another word

parts.note: I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: A question about potatoes, then someone feeling the urge to talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Potatoes have eyes, the buds from which shoots grow, so some potatoes are eyed.

clue.text: Agreed toe is deformed somewhat

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are bent out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone concedes a toe is slightly misshapen.
explanation.definitionFit: To a degree is an idiom for partly, to some extent.

clue.text: Doctor percussing a lot who will get you looking better

definitions.text: who will get you looking better

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so these letters are altered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician who taps your chest a great deal and improves your appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like the definition but is the anagram signal; percussing is a doctor tapping the body to examine it.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosmetic specialist reshapes features so patients look better afterwards.

clue.text: It may get endless representation

indicators.note: each of the three words loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Something might acquire an infinite depiction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' applies to each of It, may and get, leaving I, MA and GE.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness, a representation of something.

clue.text: Message's tenor we may hear described

definitions.note: the clue's 's is read as 'is', so this is the definition

indicators.note: said out loud, the description matches another phrase

parts.note: a tenor would be described as a voice, male

explanation.surface: The gist of a message, as we might have it described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tenor' looks like the sense or drift of the message; it is the singer's range, a male voice.
explanation.definitionFit: Voicemail is a recorded phone message left when the call is not answered.

clue.text: Think shop needs rebuke

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen, a kind of shop
to rebuke is to berate

explanation.surface: A store needs to scold someone, and has to think it over.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliberate is to ponder, consider carefully.

clue.text: No time for jokes — strap on leg

indicators.note: no time means the time letter is removed

parts.note: jokes are jests

explanation.surface: A serious person straps on a leg brace with no time for joking.
explanation.definitionFit: In falconry a jess is a short strap fastened round a hawk's leg.

clue.text: Simple game won't come to an end — I go to bed

parts.note: snap is a simple card game
something that won't end will drag on

explanation.surface: A tedious children's game goes on and on until someone heads off to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I go to bed' is a flower speaking: it is planted in a flower bed, not off to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: The snapdragon is a popular garden plant used in flower beds.

clue.text: Get cash for proper detached place, not large

parts.note: proper means real, genuine

indicators.note: not large means the large letter is removed

parts.note: an isle is land detached from the mainland

explanation.surface: Selling a genuine secluded property, though not a big one.
explanation.definitionFit: To realise assets is to convert them into money by selling.

clue.text: Queen cross with regiment holding up drink

indicators.note: in a down answer the pieces below hold up the drink sitting above them

parts.note: ale is a drink
X is a cross shape
and means with, together with
RA is the Royal Artillery regiment

explanation.surface: A monarch is annoyed that soldiers have delayed the drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like an adjective, angry, but is the letter X.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexandra was queen consort of Edward VII of Britain.

clue.text: Republic extremely embarrassed, withdrawing current coins

indicators.note: withdrawing means pulling back, so these letters run backwards

parts.note: Iran is an Islamic republic

indicators.note: extremely picks the outermost letters of embarrassed

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A country red-faced as it pulls its money out of circulation.
explanation.definitionFit: Denarii are ancient Roman silver coins, plural of denarius.

clue.text: At heart, regrets nothing in Spanish island

indicators.note: at heart picks out the central letters of regrets

parts.note: nada is Spanish for nothing

explanation.surface: On a Spanish island, someone deep down regrets nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenada is a Caribbean island nation.

clue.text: Useful feature to order any time

indicators.note: putting letters in order means arranging them afresh

explanation.surface: A handy facility available on demand at any hour.
explanation.definitionFit: An amenity is a convenience or facility, something useful a place offers.

clue.text: Burden of work papers

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
the press means the newspapers

explanation.surface: A heavy load made up of work documents.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppress is to weigh down or burden heavily.

clue.text: Managed to support some good books: here, The Castle?

indicators.note: in a down answer the lower pieces support the books above

parts.note: the Old Testament is part of the Good Book, the Bible
managed means ran, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: A puzzle about running a library of fine volumes and where a castle stands.
explanation.walkthrough: The Castle of Otranto is Horace Walpole's 1764 Gothic novel, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Walpole's novel is set at Otranto, so that is where the castle of the title is.

clue.text: Just open a container

parts.note: a jar is a container

explanation.surface: Simply open a tub or box.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left ajar is only slightly open.

clue.text: Fruit and meat including starter of rice for Chinese runner

parts.note: a pear is a fruit

indicators.note: the meat includes, holds, the starter letter

parts.note: liver is meat (offal)

indicators.note: starter of picks the first letter of rice

explanation.surface: A Chinese menu: fruit, then meat with a rice starter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' is a river, as in a crossword's flower (flow-er); 'Chinese' supports the menu picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pearl River is a major river in southern China flowing past Guangzhou.

clue.text: Rev Vicar's first study, say

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of Vicar's

parts.note: a study is an example of a room

explanation.surface: A clergyman and his own study, as in the Reverend's office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rev' looks like a reverend; it is revving an engine.
explanation.definitionFit: Vroom imitates the noise of an engine being revved.

clue.text: Bullet hit pest

definitions.meaning: a lump of metal fired from a gun
to strike hard with a fist
a slimy garden creature that eats plants

explanation.surface: A gun's projectile strikes a garden nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: Slug has all three senses: a piece of ammunition, to punch, and a shell-less garden mollusc.

clue.text: People arrest smooth boy over a little bling

indicators.note: to arrest is to hold, so the people hold the other letters

parts.note: men means people

indicators.note: over means turned over, so these letters run backwards

parts.note: to oil is to smooth
a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: Police seize a slick young man over some flashy jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: A medallion is a pendant worn as showy jewellery, a piece of flashy ornament.

clue.text: Maxim's garden feature?

definitions.meaning: a maxim is a pithy saying; 's is read as 'is'
an ornamental statuette in a garden

explanation.surface: A restaurant called Maxim's with a garden attraction.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnome is both an aphorism and a small garden statue of a bearded figure.

clue.text: Ma and Granny worried about Junior, a disillusioned playwright

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go about, around, the junior piece
the letters of the two relatives are agitated and rearranged

parts.note: a junior is young

explanation.surface: Mother and grandmother fret over a youngster who has written a play.
explanation.walkthrough: The Angry Young Men were 1950s British writers such as John Osborne.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase labels a 1950s British writer like John Osborne, disillusioned with society.
